subject: Post-call: Pilot criteria & next-step MPA outline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <am@stellarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Pilot criteria & next-step MPA outline

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the 30-minute demo today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we have aligned owners and dates. Please edit where I missed anything.

Key pain points you shared:
- Current enrichment pipeline spikes cause per-claim latency > 700ms (goal: <150ms for edge calls).
- Cost volatility when batch volumes increase during month-end reconciliations.
- Data residency concerns for PHI-derived text fields (need EU/US separation and audit logs).

Primary goals for a pilot
- Validate inference latency and throughput at target load (500 reqs/min sustained, 1k burst).
- Demonstrate predictable unit cost under continuous batching.
- Confirm integration feasibility with your message bus and KMS.

Proposed MPA (milestones, owners, suggested dates) — draft v1 attached:
1) Technical deep-dive + infra checklist (live demo of sandbox): Aug 11, Jordan & Marissa lead, Stella: Alicia + Eng lead
2) Sandbox access & onboarding (Redwood provides demo tenant + sample dataset): Aug 18-24, Ben & Stella Eng
3) 2-week pilot (integration + eval): Aug 25 — Sep 8, success criteria defined below
4) Security questionnaire & SOC 2 evidence review: Aug 18 — Sep 1, Stella Sec Ops + Jordan
5) Procurement/SOW review (pricing & terms): target sign by Sep 15, Ben lead
6) Production readiness review & rollout plan: target Oct 15

Decision gates / acceptance criteria for pilot (must meet 3 of 4):
- Average per-request latency under load < 150ms
- 95th percentile latency < 250ms
- Cost per 1k operations within agreed target (we'll model once you share monthly volumes)
- No critical security gaps identified in SOC/Q controls

Next steps I need from you:
- Confirm stakeholders (Security, Procurement, Eng manager) and any date conflicts
- If OK, I’ll post an updated MPA and calendar invites today

Thanks — happy to adjust dates if procurement or security need more lead time.

Jordan Blake
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
